Hi Karthik,

Quick procurement question as we move toward the pilot order: our finance team needs to understand a few things before they issue a PO. Can you confirm the following?

1) Can Redwood accept a formal PO (PDF) that must be referenced on every invoice (PO number on invoice line)?
2) Our standard is consolidated monthly invoicing for platform vendors. Is Redwood able to provide a single monthly invoice with line-level detail and PO number?
3) What net terms do you support? We ideally need net-45 on new vendors; some internal groups will only accept net-60 for larger contracts.
4) Do you require vendor onboarding paperwork (W-9, bank info)? If so, could you send the checklist and a contact for AP?

I'm attaching our standard PO request template to speed things up. If you can confirm by early next week, procurement will generate the PO.

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
Senior Procurement Manager
FinServCo

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below; forwarding to our finance and legal partners to ensure everything is covered operationally.

- PO on invoice: Yes. We can include a customer PO number on every invoice and on each line item.
- Consolidated monthly invoice: Yes — we can generate a single monthly invoice for usage and any overage/commit charges with line-level detail.
- Net terms: Our standard is net-30. For enterprise commitments (reserved capacity / multi-month/annual contracts) we can support net-45 on a case-by-case basis; net-60 would typically require executive approval and a credit review.
- Vendor paperwork: We require a completed W-9 and vendor setup form for US entities; bank wiring instructions are collected via a secure portal.

Proposed next steps:
1) Procurement issues PO referencing the expected SOW and including the requested PO number format.
2) We'll send a short vendor onboarding checklist + vendor portal link.
3) If FinServCo needs net-45 for the pilot, we can accommodate for the initial period; I'll confirm with Finance (cc'd).

I'll loop in Monica (Finance) and Priyom (Legal) to confirm the vendor setup cadence and any paperwork.

Best,

Hi Anna — thanks for the patience and for the template. Good news: we can accommodate your requests for the initial pilot with the following details and next steps.

What we can confirm now:
- PO on invoice: Confirmed. Every invoice will include the FinServCo PO number on the invoice header and at the line-item level.
- Invoice cadence: We will issue a single consolidated monthly invoice on the 1st business day following the month close (e.g., March usage invoiced April 1). If you prefer the 15th, we can discuss but default is EOM monthly consolidated.
- Net terms: For the pilot (estimated monthly invoice ~$3,750, annualized ~$45k), Finance is willing to accept net-45. Net-60 would require an executive sign-off and a credit review; please flag if this is a hard requirement.
- Vendor onboarding: Attached is our vendor onboarding checklist and a short invoice-schedule draft. Please complete the W-9 and vendor portal form so AP can process payments. AP contact: finance-payables@redwood.ai.

Attachments: Redwood_Inference_Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf; invoice-schedule-draft-20260301.xlsx

Next steps (suggested):
1) FinServCo issues PO referencing the pilot SOW and the agreed PO number format.
2) FinServCo returns completed W-9 and vendor setup via the secure portal link (we included DocuSign link for the SOW if you'd prefer e-sign).
3) We begin the pilot once vendor setup is complete; first invoice will be issued on the 1st business day after month close and will reference your PO.

If that works, I'll mark this as agreed and circulate a short confirmation SOW for signature. If you need net-60, let me know and I'll escalate.
